This page documents the '''new items''' added by the [[Skyrim:Arcane Accessories|Arcane Accessories]] [[Skyrim:Creation Club|Creation]].

==Apparel==
All versions of Robes of Destruction & Alteration and Robes of Conjuration & Illusion are distributed through leveled lists that contain enchanted robes.

==Spell Tomes==
Like all books, these spell tomes have a weight of 1. All tomes are found in the Ancient Tome Chest in [[Skyrim:Hob's Fall Cave|Hob's Fall Cave]], and distributed in leveled lists that contain other spell tomes.
